text:
maya: quick heads-up, the new quant-v3p1 variant we shadowed last night shows a small but consistent rerank drop on long-doc slices. posting the eval summary below :eyes:

sam: ugh ok. is it across all cohorts or focused on a specific slice?

maya: focused. mostly `long_doc_rerank` and a small bump in short hallucination FPR for system prompts. overall token cost/latency looked fine. attaching the key stats: 

maya: ```
slice: long_doc_rerank
metric: ndcg@10
baseline: 0.421
variant: 0.411
delta: -2.38%

slice: short_assistant_fp
metric: FPR
baseline: 0.007
variant: 0.014
delta: +100% (absolute +0.007)

latency p95 baseline: 210ms, variant: 215ms
```

liam: thanks for the paste. long-doc NDCG drop of ~2.4% is noisy but nontrivial. short FP doubling is more concerning even if absolute numbers are tiny.

sam: do we have subgroup population sizes? small N can blow percentages up.

maya: population sizes: long_doc_rerank n=18k, short_assistant_fp n=1.2k. not tiny.

eval-bot: automated-eval summary: composite_score_delta = -1.35% (weighted: ndcg*0.7 + fpr_penalty*0.3). regression p<0.01. severity: medium.

maya: propose we hold promotion and run a narrow A/B (1% traffic) on long-doc heavy cohorts + run targeted prompt-level probes. if signal persists, autofallback thresholds should trigger. thoughts? @sam @liam

sam: agreed on hold. propose autotriage rules:
- autofallback if composite_score_delta <= -1.5% over 24h OR
- any safety metric (FPR/hallucination) absolute increase > 0.005 for >= 3 slices

liam: +1 but tweak hysteresis: require two consecutive 6h windows breaching thresholds before triggering autofallback to avoid flapping. also add latency tail check: if p99 delta > 40ms AND composite delta < -0.8% trigger an immediate circuit-breaker.

maya: that seems reasonable. can we formalize the composite_score?

sam: quick formula suggestion: composite = 0.6 * ndcg_delta_pct + 0.4 * (-1) * normalized_safety_delta
where normalized_safety_delta scales FPR changes to comparable % impact. we should store normalization constants in gate-config.

eval-bot: noted. running fine-grained bootstrap to estimate CI now. will post results in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: deploy bot: shadow traffic finished 02:14 UTC. no infra alerts. memory GPU 2 usage steady.

maya: if bootstrap CI keeps regression p<0.05, i'll open a quick PR to add the slice to the watchlist and spin up the 1% A/B. also planning a targeted prompt suite that isolates the FP cases.

sam: add also a rollback-runbook snippet in the PR referencing the hysteresis windows and who to ping (oncall + eng-ml). we should avoid manual rescue if auto fallback works.

liam: final ask: add a smoke eval that runs long-doc retrieval + rerank end-to-end in CI with quant sim. catches these earlier.

maya: yep. i'll do PR and link to this thread. thanks all :thumbsup:

eval-bot: bootstrap finished: composite_score_delta median = -1.42%, 95% CI [-1.95%, -0.92%], p=0.003.

maya: ok data looks consistent. creating PR now and scheduling the 1% A/B tomorrow morning. will tag @sam for gate config review.
